shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat AGENTS.md && cat package-lock.json | head -30 && find .agents -type f

cat package.json index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts; find src; cat src/*; head -60 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md
.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Card Switch ThemeProvider Flex Text Tabs Icon 2>&1 | head -80; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>&1 | head

grep -n -i -B2 -A8 "gravity-ui/navigation" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -60; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/icons.md | head -50
cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json | grep '"version"'; npm view @gravity-ui/navigation peerDependencies version 2>&1 | head -30

npm install @gravity-ui/navigation @gravity-ui/icons @bem-react/classname react-router-dom@6 2>&1 | tail -8; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/dist/docs 2>&1 | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation && grep '"version"' package.json; cat build/docs/INDEX.md | head -60; ls build/docs/components; grep -n -i -A12 "required setup\|## Install\|styles" README.md | head -60
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs && cat components/AsideHeader.md | head -150; ls components/AsideHeader

grep -n -i -A25 "^## .*\(props\|properties\|Usage\)" components/AsideHeader.md | head -120; ls components/AsideHeader/; cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build; grep -rn "renderFooter\|renderContent\|FooterItem" --include=*.d.ts -l . | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs && sed -n 380,420p components/AsideHeader.md | cut -c1-260; cat ../esm/components/AsideHeader/components/FooterItem/FooterItem.d.ts; grep -n "interface AsideHeaderItem" -A40 ../esm/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts | head -70

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && sed -n 36,100p node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md; grep -n "interface MenuItem" -A25 node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/types.d.ts; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/esm 2>/dev/null | grep -E "^(House|Gear|CircleInfo|Moon|Sun|ChartColumn|Layers|Heart|Rocket|Palette|Star)\.js"
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -15; git status --short
